He told her that the shell was a “song of the sea,” a rare treasure that could grant a single wish to anyone who listened with a pure heart.

But then she remembered the quiet nights when she watched the waves and felt the wind on her wings, and she realized what truly mattered: the simple joy of sharing moments with friends.
